A-SILVER Review

Review of A-SILVER

The 2013-built (as Amadeus Silver) cruise ship A-SILVER is a 180-passenger riverboat owned by the Austrian company and shipowner Luftner Cruises and operated through the Luftner-owned travel brand Amadeus River Cruises. The ship is also frequently chartered by the German cruisetour company Phoenix Reisen.

The vessel (ENI number 2335475) is currently Germany-flagged (MMSI 211603060) and registered in Cologne.

Cabins

MS Amadeus Silver offers 90 staterooms spread across four decks — the open-air Sun Deck and three passenger decks named after famous Austrian composers: Haydn, Mozart, and Strauss.

The riverboat has 78 standard cabins (16 m² / 170 ft²) and 12 Amadeus Balcony Suites (24 m² / 260 ft²) with walk-out exterior balconies.

All accommodations feature twin beds (convertible to queen-size), a private bathroom with shower, a seating area, cabinets, TV, and telephone. Suites also include minibars.

Shipboard Facilities

Meals are served in the Panorama Restaurant on Mozart Deck. Guests can enjoy early morning light bites, buffet breakfast, buffet or sit-down lunch, and five-course gourmet dinners with complimentary regional wines. All dishes are prepared using fresh, locally-sourced ingredients. Afternoon tea and cake service and midnight snacks are also available.

Guests can relax on the Sun Deck, which offers scenic views, deck chairs, a putting green, giant chessboard, and shuffleboard. Additional onboard amenities include a massage room, hair salon, fitness room, Internet station, Panorama Bar, and the Amadeus Club.

During shore excursions, guests have access to complimentary bicycles and wireless audio systems.

Note: You can view CruiseMapper's list of all river cruise ships and riverboats in the "itinerary" section of our River Cruises hub. All cruise companies and their fleets are listed there.
